description:
Long-Range Removable Battery
Powered by a robust 48V 23.4Ah (1123.2Wh) lithium battery, the HITWAY BK30 delivers an impressive riding range of 90–180 km per charge. A 3.0A fast charger reduces charging time, saving you valuable hours. The removable design makes charging simple and secure—whether at home, at work, or on the go.
High-Performance Motor with Strong Climbing Power
Equipped with a 250W brushless hub motor delivering 70Nm of torque, the BK30 easily conquers slopes up to 25°. Smooth, efficient, and reliable, it’s perfect for city commutes, rugged trails, and long-distance rides. The built-in 6 km/h push assist throttle helps you start effortlessly and tackle challenging terrain with ease.
Dual Suspension and Sturdy Frame
A front fork suspension paired with a rear air shock system absorbs bumps and vibrations on rough roads, providing maximum comfort. The heavy-duty carbon steel frame supports riders up to 120 kg, ensuring both stability and long-lasting durability.
Wide Fat Tires and Reliable Braking
With 20×4.0 inch puncture-resistant fat tires, this e-bike handles snow, sand, gravel, and other challenging terrains with ease, delivering excellent grip and stability. Dual disc brakes provide powerful and responsive stopping power in all weather conditions, giving you greater safety and control.
Smart Display and Enhanced Safety Features
The multifunctional LCD display clearly shows speed, distance, battery status, power, and ride time, while instantly detecting errors for added peace of mind. NFC unlocking allows you to secure and unlock your e-bike with ease, offering extra theft protection. Bright front and rear LED lights ensure excellent visibility at night, making evening rides safer and more enjoyable.
